en.t: K's adoptive father's household was also quite wealthy.

units.source_text: 他就是由养父出资来东京上学的。

en.t: It was his adoptive father who paid for him to come to Tokyo to study.

units.source_text: 我们并不是一起来的，可是到了东京后，就住进了同一个寄宿处。

en.t: We did not come together, but after arriving in Tokyo we ended up living in the same boarding house.

units.source_text: 那时候，一间屋子里常常住两三个人，并排摆着各自的桌子。

en.t: In those days, two or three people often shared one room, each setting his desk side by side with the others.

units.source_text: K和我也是两个人住在一起。

en.t: K and I also lived together, just the two of us.

units.source_text: 我们两人就像被人从山里捉来的动物似的，在兽栏里紧紧依偎着，瞪着外面。

en.t: The two of us were like animals captured in the mountains, huddling close together in a cage and glaring out at the world outside.

units.source_text: 我们俩害怕东京和东京人，但是，在六叠大的房间里，我们却纵论时弊，睥睨天下。

en.t: We were afraid of Tokyo and its people, yet inside our six-mat room we talked grandly about the troubles of the day and looked down on the whole world.

units.source_text: 我们确实满怀凌云壮志，想要出人头地，特别是K，更是心性好强。

en.t: We truly were filled with lofty ambitions and wanted to make something of ourselves, and K in particular had an especially strong and competitive spirit.

units.source_text: 出生于寺院的他，动辄口称‘精进’。

en.t: Having been born in a temple, he was always talking about devotion and discipline.

units.source_text: 在我看来，他的行动坐卧几乎都可以用‘精进’一词来形容。

en.t: To my eyes, nearly everything he did, in action or at rest, could be described by that one word, devotion.
I often felt a private reverence and awe toward him.
